verdict_reasons: no cross-class near-duplicates above the cutoff
note: Read-only. A 'review' verdict means the frames below the distance cutoff need a human pass before the class is trained; it is not a rejection of the class. This scan detects duplicate frames, not taxa: a Thalassia photo misfiled under Enhalus is only caught when a near-identical file also exists in a Thalassia folder. The sampled human pass is what covers the rest.
